notes: A pursuing horror antagonist you flee toward an exit is the Escape preset unchanged, and the pressure being a chase rather than a locked door keeps it in Survival rather than Puzzle. warren-looping is the preset's own shape and the right one here: the granny is stated to be AI throughout, so the corridors must loop with no dead end for the chase to stay fair, and that P6 is structural and stays. Dropped the preset's building-interior because the answers put the whole round on one floor of the facility with no outside, so nothing transitions indoors and the build stays off P3, and left out collectible-nodes since the answers rule out keys. Decided without a user that the exit door on the boundary is the round-win trigger and that hiding cutouts along the corridors are wanted, since evasion is the only defence against an AI that never stops chasing; no spawn-protected, as no player ever plays the granny.
